# CMHA Toronto

> > CMHA Toronto provides mental health support, crisis services, suicide prevention training, and community programs across Toronto and Scarborough.

The Canadian Mental Health Association Toronto branch offers comprehensive mental health services including ASIST suicide intervention training, stepped care programs, employment support, housing initiatives, and virtual care hubs. Key locations include 700 Lawrence Ave W and 1200 Markham Rd in Scarborough.

## Key Topics

- ASIST (Applied Suicide Intervention Skills Training)
- LivingWorks suicide prevention
- Mental health crisis intervention
- Stepped care treatment
- Housing First Team
- Toronto Community Crisis Service
- Nurse Practitioner Stepped Care Program
- Virtual Community Care Hubs
- Circle of Belonging monthly giving
- Employment support services
- Stigma reduction and bias awareness
- Empathy training
- Community mental health programs
- 700 Lawrence Ave W location
- 1200 Markham Rd Scarborough location

## Core Programs & Services

- [Nurse Practitioner Stepped Care Program](https://cmhato.org/programs/nurse-practitioner-stepped-care-program): Stepped care treatment for serious mental illness post-ACT transition
- [Virtual Community Care Hubs](https://cmhato.org/programs/virtual-community-care-hubs): Community telehealth access points for mental health services
- [Circle of Belonging - Monthly Giving](https://cmhato.org/get-involved/circle-of-belonging): Monthly donor program supporting mental health community initiatives

## ASIST Suicide Prevention Training

- [ASIST Training - June 24-25, 2026 (700 Lawrence Ave W)](https://cmhato.org/workshops/asist-training-for-individuals-june-24-and-25-2026-700-lawrence-ave-w): 2-day LivingWorks ASIST suicide prevention intervention training
- [ASIST Training - April 29-30 (700 Lawrence Ave W)](https://cmhato.org/workshops/asist-training-for-individuals-april-29-and-30-700-lawrence-ave-w): 2-day ASIST suicide intervention training at Lawrence Ave location

## Workshops & Training

- [Navigating Mental Health and Biases: Empathy in Conversations](https://cmhato.org/workshops/navigating-mental-health-and-biases-empathy-in-conversations): Workshop on mental health empathy, bias awareness & stigma reduction

## News & Stories

- [Creating a space for safety and support](https://cmhato.org/news/creating-a-space-for-safety-and-support): Toronto Community Crisis Service pilot program for mental health crisis
- [Wear Your Art On Your Sleeve](https://cmhato.org/news/wear-your-art-on-your-sleeve): Housing First Team art therapy project for homelessness recovery
- [A day in the life of an employment support worker](https://cmhato.org/news/a-day-in-the-life-of-an-employment-support-worker): Profile of Ashleigh Rice & Employment Program job placement services
